prompt: A quiet coastal road on a clear morning. Soft steady sea breeze and distant gentle surf below the seawall. Natural restrained ambience, consistent distance, no people, no voices, no birds, no vehicles, no music, no dramatic gusts or impacts.

model.name: MOSS-SoundEffect-v2.0
model.weightsRevision: pinned by per-file revisions and SHA256 in source-metadata.json (17 files); ModelScope branch used for transport: master
model.license: Apache-2.0 (model card and pyproject); generated output is not relicensed as CC0 by this project
model.access: No gated consent page used; no credentials or paid service.

processing.recipe: ffmpeg highpass 25 Hz / mono 48 kHz f32; equal-power last-first 0.75s loop seam; fixed RMS 0.08 with 0.9 peak ceiling; dual-mono PCM16 stereo

selection: seed 0 selected for more 200-2000 Hz presence (29.8% vs 5.3% band energy) while remaining quiet; no subjective listening was performed.

environment.precision: bfloat16, batch 1, 100 steps, 30 s latent (10 s output)
environment.note: No OOM. The desktop GPU was already in use, and the driver reserved more than the 12.2 GB of dedicated memory (shared-memory oversubscription). Headroom is marginal, not a clean 12 GB fit. First seed was slower than the warmed second seed.
